endorsements.quote: These tools must be designed to be explainable so that doctors can understand how the machine arrived at the recommended diagnosis (e.g., the use of an X-ray machine) (Lysaght et al., 2019 ).
In this sense, such systems must respect the primacy of human judgment and ensure that clinicians retain meaningful control over decisions affecting patient care.

Xivuri and Twinomurinzi ( 2022 ) and Rehg ( 2015 ) agree that individuals affected by AI algorithms or by decisions made by AI algorithms should be involved in the planning and development stages of AI algorithms.

unlisted_practices: Design AI-based clinical decision support systems as dialogical, process-oriented tools that support rather than replace human judgment.
Embed discursive ethical procedures, including stakeholder dialogue and rational justification of norms, within the development and deployment of AI clinical decision support systems.
Involve human experts trained in ethical reasoning and moral philosophy in the design and evaluation of AI clinical decision support systems.
Detect emergent biases in AI clinical decision support systems and use them for timely feedback and system improvement.

screen.reason: This is a theoretical and normative framework paper proposing discursive ethics as a foundation for integrating ethical principles and governance into AI-based clinical decision support systems.
